description:
We want to change the world. We’re a team of fast-executing social entrepreneurs on a mission to build the future of social change. You want to change the world? This is your chance!
   
 We’re not looking for someone to do busy work or implement another Rails app. We are searching for an outstanding front end developer to build our business with! We want someone who sees iFLIP4 in its Beta stages, and who can envision a future where it is the place to go for EVERYONE who cares. We want someone who wants to create the future, not someone who will settle for an unfulfilling position at a giant corporation. 
   
 We don’t want a code monkey; we don’t want someone to say yes and implement every feature we ask for. What we want is a partner. Someone to bounce ideas off of, someone with a vision for the future of our company, and someone who has the desire and drive to make it a reality. 
   
 Importantly, the most driven, high performing interns will be given the opportunity to take on full time roles after we raise our Angel round of funding. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 Code the full version of iFLIP4’s website, which has been expertly designed by a Web Designer with a Masters in HCI from Carnegie Mellon 

 Maintain and update the current Beta website on a regular basis 

 Design and implement reusable cross-platform features 

 Create responsive webpages 

 Brainstorm new design ideas and upcoming apps with other members of the technical, design, and Core teams 

 
 Technical Requirements 
 Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/JQuery 

 1-2 years of web development experience, with impressive past projects 

 LAMP stack experience 

 MVC experience 

 Knowledge of ExpressionEngine Framework 

 Strong understanding of SEO 

 Degree in Computer Science/Design 

 Great English communication skills, both written and spoken 

 Ability to visualize your ideas beautifully in Illustrator/Photoshop a plus 

 
 
 Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/JQuery

 1-2 years of web development experience, with impressive past projects

 LAMP stack experience

 MVC experience

 Knowledge of ExpressionEngine Framework

 Strong understanding of SEO

 Degree in Computer Science/Design

 Great English communication skills, both written and spoken

 Ability to visualize your ideas beautifully in Illustrator/Photoshop a plus

 

 This position requires a commitment of about 20 hours/week. After we raise our Angel round of funding, this role can grow into a full-time position with a full salary and vested equity in iFLIP4, assuming the work you do is great! We are located in East Hanover, NJ, and telecommuting is fine with us.
